title: Enforcement Decree of the Special Act on the Restoration of Honor of Participants in the Donghak Peasant Revolution and Others
title_original: 동학농민혁명 참여자 등의 명예회복에 관한 특별법 시행령
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters delegated by the Special Act on the Restoration of Honor of Participants in the Donghak Peasant Revolution and Others and matters necessary for its enforcement. <Amended June 4, 2007>

Article 2 (Composition of the Committee for Deliberation on Restoration of Honor of Participants in the Donghak Peasant Revolution)
Among the members of the Committee for Deliberation on Restoration of Honor of Participants in the Donghak Peasant Revolution (hereinafter referred to as the "Committee") under Article 3 of the Special Act on the Restoration of Honor of Participants in the Donghak Peasant Revolution and Others (hereinafter referred to as the "Act"), members who are relevant public officials shall be director-general-level officials of the Ministry of the Interior and Safety, the Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs, the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism, and the Ministry of Planning and Budget, respectively designated by the head of each institution. <Amended April 11, 2023; December 30, 2025>

Article 3 (Duties of the Chairperson)
(1) The chairperson of the Committee shall represent the Committee and exercise overall control of its affairs.
(2) Where the chairperson is unable to perform the duties for an unavoidable reason, a member designated in advance by the chairperson shall act on the chairperson's behalf.

Article 4 (Meetings of the Committee)
(1) The chairperson of the Committee shall convene its meetings and preside over them.
(2) A meeting of the Committee shall open with a majority of all incumbent members, including the chairperson, present, and resolutions shall be adopted by the affirmative votes of a majority of the members present.
(3) Where a member who is a public official is unable to attend a meeting of the Committee for an unavoidable reason, a public official designated by that member may act on the member's behalf. <Added March 20, 2018>

Article 5 Deleted. <March 20, 2018>

Article 6 Deleted. <March 20, 2018>

Article 7 Deleted. <March 20, 2018>

Article 8 (Applications for Registration of Surviving Family Members)
(1) A person seeking recognition as a surviving family member under Article 5(1) of the Act shall submit to the Committee an application for registration as a surviving family member of a participant in the Donghak Peasant Revolution using attached Form 1, with the following documents attached: <Amended June 12, 2006; June 4, 2007; May 4, 2010; November 2, 2010; March 20, 2018>
1. One copy of materials or literature proving that the applicant's parent, grandparent, great-grandparent or great-great-grandparent was a participant in the Donghak Peasant Revolution.
2. One copy of documents relating to the household register of the participant in the Donghak Peasant Revolution.
3. A certificate of matters recorded in the applicant's family relations register.
4. One copy of other evidentiary materials showing that the applicant is a surviving family member.
(2) Upon receiving an application under paragraph (1), the Committee shall enter it in the register of received applications for registration of surviving family members using attached Form 2. <Amended March 20, 2018>

Article 9 (Decisions)
(1) When the Committee deliberates and decides on determination and registration of participants in the Donghak Peasant Revolution and their surviving family members under Article 5(2) of the Act, it shall prepare a determination of participants in the Donghak Peasant Revolution and surviving family members using attached Form 3, stating the following matters: <Amended June 4, 2007; December 30, 2015; December 31, 2015; March 20, 2018>
1. The applicant's name, address and date of birth.
2. The operative part of the decision.
3. The reasons for the decision.
4. The year, month and day of the decision.
(2) Where the Committee prepares a determination under paragraph (1), it shall register the surviving family members and, within 10 days from the deliberation and decision, send to the applicant (including by electronic transmission) a notice of registration of surviving family members of a participant in the Donghak Peasant Revolution using attached Form 4 (or, if the surviving family members are not registered, the result of the deliberation and decision). <Amended June 4, 2007; March 20, 2018>
(3) Deleted. <March 20, 2018>

Article 10 (Preparation and Keeping of a Roster)
(1) The Committee shall prepare and keep a roster of participants in the Donghak Peasant Revolution and surviving family members determined and registered under Article 9, using attached Form 5. <Amended June 4, 2007>
(2) Where an applicant for registration, a person concerned or a similar person requests inspection of the roster, the Committee shall permit the inspection.
(3) Preparation, keeping and inspection of the roster under paragraphs (1) and (2) may be conducted by electronic information processing. <Added March 20, 2018>

Article 11 (Allowances and Other Payments)
(1) Members attending a meeting of the Committee may be paid allowances and travel expenses within budgetary limits. However, this shall not apply where a member who is a public official attends the Committee in direct connection with the official's duties. <Amended March 20, 2018>
(2) Where the Committee hears opinions from applicants for registration, persons with relevant information or similar persons, or conducts verification or fact-finding investigations, it may reimburse their actual expenses, including travel expenses, within budgetary limits. <Amended March 20, 2018>

Article 11-2 (Entrustment of Committee Operation and Administrative Affairs)
The Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism shall entrust operation of the Committee and handling of its administrative affairs to the Donghak Peasant Revolution Memorial Foundation under Article 9 of the Act, pursuant to Article 10(1) of the Act.

Article 12 (Detailed Enforcement Rules)
Except as provided in this Decree, matters necessary for its enforcement, including operation of the Committee, shall be determined by the chairperson following a resolution of the Committee.
